purpose: Test whether shared-capacity observation recourse survives same-information strong baselines; do not label standard POMDP lookahead as novel.

source.no_cleaned_trace: Do not select away correlated failures or unusually high churn. Report observation-boundary censoring.

split.fit: Only primary training period. Independent-site local training is a labeled diagnostic, never used by the primary transfer controller.
split.node_identifiers: No identifiers as learned features; hash only for deterministic sample selection.
split.unknown: Before first up interval and at/after final end: unknown, not failure. Cut replay at first unknown among chosen nodes and retain censored denominators.
split.window_selection: Nonoverlapping 32-slot windows in each split, at most 240 development and 480 test windows, evenly spaced. Select six nodes by SHA256(dataset/window_start/node_id), only requiring an earlier observed up at the start, not future availability.

prediction.model: Pooled continuous-time two-state Markov rates with Jeffreys half-event smoothing; fit transitions and exposure on primary train only; rescale via exact matrix exponential for native time steps.
prediction.observation: All controllers see their own attempted destinations' outcomes only, delivered at end of slot. At start they share the immediately previous recorded sample as initial state. No future up/down events, future arrival seeds, or true outage ages enter controller input.
prediction.recurrence: Both up-to-down and down-to-up transitions are allowed. An observed success is never permanent recovery.
prediction.assumption: Binary reachability observations are exogenous to the tiny modeled workload. This does not identify server processing capacity or real Flink service latency.

workload.contract: At most one head record attempt per destination and K total attempts per slot. Failure consumes one slot and retains the record; success completes one record and reveals reachability. Expired or buffer-rejected records are reported. All policies have identical total buffers and action options.
workload.label: Synthetic bounded read-only enrichment workload on real historical reachability, not production traffic or measured throughput.

mechanism.candidate: Joint two-slot recourse evaluates the actual displaced service and the outcome-dependent next shared allocation. Its contrast with additive single-destination bids isolates nonseparable opportunity cost.
mechanism.novelty: The Bellman recurrence and two-step lookahead are established methods. Only a demonstrated structural failure of separable bidding plus a distinguishable new efficient mechanism could support a novelty claim; this phase can falsify that research path.
mechanism.no_separate_probe: Under equal cost, equal observation and nonnegative read-only payload value, a pure probe is weakly dominated by a productive attempt. This elementary dominance observation is not claimed as a new theorem.

analysis.primary: Paired completed-value difference joint_two_step minus the development-selected strongest causal comparator, at K=2; bootstrap whole nonoverlapping time windows, 2000 resamples, seed 23028.
analysis.mechanism_contrast: joint_two_step minus independent_two_step using identical beliefs, model, workloads, deadlines and two-slot horizon.
analysis.gate: Positive paired lower 95% bound at K=2 on both primary and independent transfer test, positive versus independent_two_step on both, no free capacity/buffer/information advantage. Passing performance gates still does not establish novelty.
analysis.failure_actions: Diagnose objective mismatch, forecast shift, recurrence, horizon truncation, and workload/measurement mismatch. Preserve nulls. No test-driven parameter change or trace substitution.
